messages:
ajay: quick Q — where's the dashboard that shows per-model GPU SM%, GPU mem (GB + %), KV cache hitrate, and avg batch size? Trying to debug a tail-latency spike; one pool showed a lot of evictions. any panel ids or direct links? cc @maria

maria: there are two dashboards i usually look at:
- GPU overview: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/1a2b3c/gpu-overview (panels: SM% = 17, GPU mem = 23, avg batch = 41)
- KV cache health: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/4d5e6f/kv-cache-health (panels: kv_hit_rate = 7, evictions = 9)

maria: quick promql i paste into panels for per-model kv hitrate:
```
(sum by(model,pool) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total{pool=~"pool-.*",model=~".*"}[5m]))
/
(sum by(model,pool) (rate(kv_cache_lookups_total{pool=~"pool-.*",model=~".*"}[5m]))) * 100
```

leo: also watch `kvcache_evictions_total` and `gpu_memory_pressure_ratio` (we expose both absolute GB and %). panels 9 and 23 on those dashboards. if evictions spike > ~5% over 5m we see tail latency regressions.

maria: current alerting lives in infra/monitoring/alerts/gpu-alerts.yaml in the monorepo — rule for evictions is currently: `for: 5m`, `expr: increase(kvcache_evictions_total[5m]) / increase(kvcache_lookups_total[5m]) > 0.05` with severity=warning. we discussed bumping to 0.08 for canaries last week.

ajay: perfect — where's that YAML? i have no perms to edit alerts but can propose change for pool-canary.

maria: link -> https://git.internal.redwood.ai/infra/monitoring/-/blob/main/alerts/gpu-alerts.yaml. open MR with a rationale: "reduce eviction sensitivity for canary pools to avoid noisy pages". add `labels: {pool: "pool-canary"}` to target it.

infra-sre: fyi when you request threshold changes, include: how long you want the exception, observed baseline, and rollback criteria. i'll approve if reasoning looks good. if mem pressure > 0.85 for >10m, page immediately.

ajay: plan: reduce max_batch from 64 -> 48 for model=vision-lite on pool-canary, monitor kv hit and evictions for 30m, if tail latency improves we keep and open MR to adjust alert. i'll ping here when i flip it. :+1:

leo: ping me before you flip so i can tail traces and check sampler. tracing quick link: https://traces.redwood.ai/search?service=gpu-serving&pool=pool-canary

opsbot: deploy scheduled by ajay: infra/gpu-config#update (runbook: https://runbook.redwood.ai/gpu-batch-adjust). If any regression, rollback with `kubectl -n gpu set image ...` and notify #eng-runtime.

ajay: thanks all. i'll run the change in ~5m and report back with numbers (kv hit %, evictions count, 95p latency).

maria: sg. if you want a quick grafana snapshot command: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GRAF_TOKEN\" "https://grafana.redwood.ai/render/d-solo/1a2b3c/gpu-overview?panelId=17&orgId=1&from=now-30m&to=now&width=1000&height=400" > sm.png`

leo: :thumbsup: good luck.

ajay: update: lowered batch, after 10m kv hit stable (~92%), evictions down ~60% vs baseline, 95p latency improved ~180ms. rolling to 2 more canaries now.

maria: awesome data — open the MR to update alert thresholds for canary pools and i'll shepherd it in infra.

infra-sre: noted. I'll watch the page policy while you roll.

ajay: will do, thanks everyone.
